description: Shared contract for sidebar group sync. The web app (web/public/sidebar-sync.js) and the macOS app (Sources/AgentHub/Services/SidebarOrder.swift) must resolve every case below identically. Both test suites read this file: web/test/contract.test.js and Tests/AllMyAgentsTests/ContractTests.swift. A rule that changes on one side only fails the other side's suite, which is the whole point — the groups-protected rule was ported into the macOS app by hand, and the hand-port silently drifted. Amended by ADR 0017: group membership is server-declared (a session carries the group it belongs to), so the synced store keeps order, collapsed state and ungrouped order, and the groupsCleared flag is gone.

winnerCases.name: a copy with groups is not erased by a newer copy without them
a copy without groups is not erased by an older copy with them
when both copies have groups, the newer one wins
when both copies have groups, the older one loses
a blank copy never erases the server's groups
an empty copy never erases the server's groups even when it is newer
two blank copies have nothing to sync
a legacy copy with content beats an empty copy
a legacy empty copy loses to a legacy copy with content
two copies with groups and the same timestamp keep the local one

flagCases.name: a copy with one group has groups
a group with no members still counts as a group
an empty copy has no groups
